//Note: The Javascript escape and unescape functions do not correspond with what browsers actually do...

// This function decodes the  Percent encoded URL,
// Replace %xx with equivalent character
// Put [ERROR] in output if %xx is invalid.
function decode_url(url) 
{
    var HEXCHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef";
    var encoded = url;
	var plaintext = "";
	var i = 0;
	while (i < encoded.length) {
		var ch = encoded.charAt(i);

		if (ch == "%") {
			if (i < (encoded.length-2)
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+1)) != -1
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+2)) != -1 ) {
			plaintext += unescape( encoded.substr(i,3) );
			i += 3;
			} else {
			// Bad escape combination  at encoded.substr(i)
			alert('Bad Request');
			plaintext += "%[ERROR]";
			i++;
			}
		} else {
			plaintext += ch;
			i++;
		}
	} // while
return plaintext;
}

//This function performs Percent encoding on URL as per RFC 1738, However it considers following  "/:?&=" as SAFE CHARCTERS
function encode_url(url) 
{
	var SAFECHARS = "0123456789" + // Numeric
	"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" + // Alphabetic
	"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" +
	"-_.!~*'()" + // RFC2396 Mark characters and RFC 1738 special characters.
	"/:?&="; // RSA SAFE CHARCTERS

	var HEX = "0123456789ABCDEF";
	var plaintext = url;
	var encoded = "";
	
	for (var i = 0; i < plaintext.length; i++ ) {
		var ch = plaintext.charAt(i);
		if (SAFECHARS.indexOf(ch) != -1) {
			encoded += ch;
		} else {
			var charCode = ch.charCodeAt(0);
			if (charCode > 255) {
				alert( "Unicode Character are not supported in URL" );
				encoded += "+";
			} else {
				encoded += "%";
				encoded += HEX.charAt((charCode >> 4) & 0xF);
				encoded += HEX.charAt(charCode & 0xF);
			}
		}
	}

return encoded;
}

// Modified to  handle XSS . Change the  url  with re-ecoded values
function go_url()
{
	decoded_url = decode_url("%2Fnbshomeredirector%2Easp");
	encoded_url = encode_url(decoded_url);
	location.replace(encoded_url);
}

function frametop()
{
  if (!(top === self))
  {
    document.write = '';
    setTimeout(function(){document.body.innerHTML='';},1);
    window.self.onload=function(evt){document.body.innerHTML='';};
    window.top.location = window.self.location;
  }
}

function check_popup()
{
    frametop();
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopup") {
		alert('Authentication successful');
		window.close();
	} 
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopupLogoff") {
		// Close this after 1.4 seconds
        setTimeout("window.close()", 1400);
	}
	else
    { 
        if ( true ) {
		    setTimeout("go_url()", 1 * 1000);
        }
    }
}

//Note: The Javascript escape and unescape functions do not correspond with what browsers actually do...

// This function decodes the  Percent encoded URL,
// Replace %xx with equivalent character
// Put [ERROR] in output if %xx is invalid.
function decode_url(url) 
{
    var HEXCHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef";
    var encoded = url;
	var plaintext = "";
	var i = 0;
	while (i < encoded.length) {
		var ch = encoded.charAt(i);

		if (ch == "%") {
			if (i < (encoded.length-2)
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+1)) != -1
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+2)) != -1 ) {
			plaintext += unescape( encoded.substr(i,3) );
			i += 3;
			} else {
			// Bad escape combination  at encoded.substr(i)
			alert('Bad Request');
			plaintext += "%[ERROR]";
			i++;
			}
		} else {
			plaintext += ch;
			i++;
		}
	} // while
return plaintext;
}

//This function performs Percent encoding on URL as per RFC 1738, However it considers following  "/:?&=" as SAFE CHARCTERS
function encode_url(url) 
{
	var SAFECHARS = "0123456789" + // Numeric
	"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" + // Alphabetic
	"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" +
	"-_.!~*'()" + // RFC2396 Mark characters and RFC 1738 special characters.
	"/:?&="; // RSA SAFE CHARCTERS

	var HEX = "0123456789ABCDEF";
	var plaintext = url;
	var encoded = "";
	
	for (var i = 0; i < plaintext.length; i++ ) {
		var ch = plaintext.charAt(i);
		if (SAFECHARS.indexOf(ch) != -1) {
			encoded += ch;
		} else {
			var charCode = ch.charCodeAt(0);
			if (charCode > 255) {
				alert( "Unicode Character are not supported in URL" );
				encoded += "+";
			} else {
				encoded += "%";
				encoded += HEX.charAt((charCode >> 4) & 0xF);
				encoded += HEX.charAt(charCode & 0xF);
			}
		}
	}

return encoded;
}

// Modified to  handle XSS . Change the  url  with re-ecoded values
function go_url()
{
	decoded_url = decode_url("%2Fnbshomeredirector%2Easp");
	encoded_url = encode_url(decoded_url);
	location.replace(encoded_url);
}

function frametop()
{
  if (!(top === self))
  {
    document.write = '';
    setTimeout(function(){document.body.innerHTML='';},1);
    window.self.onload=function(evt){document.body.innerHTML='';};
    window.top.location = window.self.location;
  }
}

function check_popup()
{
    frametop();
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopup") {
		alert('Authentication successful');
		window.close();
	} 
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopupLogoff") {
		// Close this after 1.4 seconds
        setTimeout("window.close()", 1400);
	}
	else
    { 
        if ( true ) {
		    setTimeout("go_url()", 1 * 1000);
        }
    }
}

//Note: The Javascript escape and unescape functions do not correspond with what browsers actually do...

// This function decodes the  Percent encoded URL,
// Replace %xx with equivalent character
// Put [ERROR] in output if %xx is invalid.
function decode_url(url) 
{
    var HEXCHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef";
    var encoded = url;
	var plaintext = "";
	var i = 0;
	while (i < encoded.length) {
		var ch = encoded.charAt(i);

		if (ch == "%") {
			if (i < (encoded.length-2)
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+1)) != -1
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+2)) != -1 ) {
			plaintext += unescape( encoded.substr(i,3) );
			i += 3;
			} else {
			// Bad escape combination  at encoded.substr(i)
			alert('Bad Request');
			plaintext += "%[ERROR]";
			i++;
			}
		} else {
			plaintext += ch;
			i++;
		}
	} // while
return plaintext;
}

//This function performs Percent encoding on URL as per RFC 1738, However it considers following  "/:?&=" as SAFE CHARCTERS
function encode_url(url) 
{
	var SAFECHARS = "0123456789" + // Numeric
	"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" + // Alphabetic
	"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" +
	"-_.!~*'()" + // RFC2396 Mark characters and RFC 1738 special characters.
	"/:?&="; // RSA SAFE CHARCTERS

	var HEX = "0123456789ABCDEF";
	var plaintext = url;
	var encoded = "";
	
	for (var i = 0; i < plaintext.length; i++ ) {
		var ch = plaintext.charAt(i);
		if (SAFECHARS.indexOf(ch) != -1) {
			encoded += ch;
		} else {
			var charCode = ch.charCodeAt(0);
			if (charCode > 255) {
				alert( "Unicode Character are not supported in URL" );
				encoded += "+";
			} else {
				encoded += "%";
				encoded += HEX.charAt((charCode >> 4) & 0xF);
				encoded += HEX.charAt(charCode & 0xF);
			}
		}
	}

return encoded;
}

// Modified to  handle XSS . Change the  url  with re-ecoded values
function go_url()
{
	decoded_url = decode_url("%2Fnbshomeredirector%2Easp");
	encoded_url = encode_url(decoded_url);
	location.replace(encoded_url);
}

function frametop()
{
  if (!(top === self))
  {
    document.write = '';
    setTimeout(function(){document.body.innerHTML='';},1);
    window.self.onload=function(evt){document.body.innerHTML='';};
    window.top.location = window.self.location;
  }
}

function check_popup()
{
    frametop();
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopup") {
		alert('Authentication successful');
		window.close();
	} 
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopupLogoff") {
		// Close this after 1.4 seconds
        setTimeout("window.close()", 1400);
	}
	else
    { 
        if ( true ) {
		    setTimeout("go_url()", 1 * 1000);
        }
    }
}

//Note: The Javascript escape and unescape functions do not correspond with what browsers actually do...

// This function decodes the  Percent encoded URL,
// Replace %xx with equivalent character
// Put [ERROR] in output if %xx is invalid.
function decode_url(url) 
{
    var HEXCHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef";
    var encoded = url;
	var plaintext = "";
	var i = 0;
	while (i < encoded.length) {
		var ch = encoded.charAt(i);

		if (ch == "%") {
			if (i < (encoded.length-2)
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+1)) != -1
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+2)) != -1 ) {
			plaintext += unescape( encoded.substr(i,3) );
			i += 3;
			} else {
			// Bad escape combination  at encoded.substr(i)
			alert('Bad Request');
			plaintext += "%[ERROR]";
			i++;
			}
		} else {
			plaintext += ch;
			i++;
		}
	} // while
return plaintext;
}

//This function performs Percent encoding on URL as per RFC 1738, However it considers following  "/:?&=" as SAFE CHARCTERS
function encode_url(url) 
{
	var SAFECHARS = "0123456789" + // Numeric
	"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" + // Alphabetic
	"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" +
	"-_.!~*'()" + // RFC2396 Mark characters and RFC 1738 special characters.
	"/:?&="; // RSA SAFE CHARCTERS

	var HEX = "0123456789ABCDEF";
	var plaintext = url;
	var encoded = "";
	
	for (var i = 0; i < plaintext.length; i++ ) {
		var ch = plaintext.charAt(i);
		if (SAFECHARS.indexOf(ch) != -1) {
			encoded += ch;
		} else {
			var charCode = ch.charCodeAt(0);
			if (charCode > 255) {
				alert( "Unicode Character are not supported in URL" );
				encoded += "+";
			} else {
				encoded += "%";
				encoded += HEX.charAt((charCode >> 4) & 0xF);
				encoded += HEX.charAt(charCode & 0xF);
			}
		}
	}

return encoded;
}

// Modified to  handle XSS . Change the  url  with re-ecoded values
function go_url()
{
	decoded_url = decode_url("%2Fnbshomeredirector%2Easp");
	encoded_url = encode_url(decoded_url);
	location.replace(encoded_url);
}

function frametop()
{
  if (!(top === self))
  {
    document.write = '';
    setTimeout(function(){document.body.innerHTML='';},1);
    window.self.onload=function(evt){document.body.innerHTML='';};
    window.top.location = window.self.location;
  }
}

function check_popup()
{
    frametop();
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopup") {
		alert('Authentication successful');
		window.close();
	} 
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopupLogoff") {
		// Close this after 1.4 seconds
        setTimeout("window.close()", 1400);
	}
	else
    { 
        if ( true ) {
		    setTimeout("go_url()", 1 * 1000);
        }
    }
}

//Note: The Javascript escape and unescape functions do not correspond with what browsers actually do...

// This function decodes the  Percent encoded URL,
// Replace %xx with equivalent character
// Put [ERROR] in output if %xx is invalid.
function decode_url(url) 
{
    var HEXCHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef";
    var encoded = url;
	var plaintext = "";
	var i = 0;
	while (i < encoded.length) {
		var ch = encoded.charAt(i);

		if (ch == "%") {
			if (i < (encoded.length-2)
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+1)) != -1
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+2)) != -1 ) {
			plaintext += unescape( encoded.substr(i,3) );
			i += 3;
			} else {
			// Bad escape combination  at encoded.substr(i)
			alert('Bad Request');
			plaintext += "%[ERROR]";
			i++;
			}
		} else {
			plaintext += ch;
			i++;
		}
	} // while
return plaintext;
}

//This function performs Percent encoding on URL as per RFC 1738, However it considers following  "/:?&=" as SAFE CHARCTERS
function encode_url(url) 
{
	var SAFECHARS = "0123456789" + // Numeric
	"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" + // Alphabetic
	"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" +
	"-_.!~*'()" + // RFC2396 Mark characters and RFC 1738 special characters.
	"/:?&="; // RSA SAFE CHARCTERS

	var HEX = "0123456789ABCDEF";
	var plaintext = url;
	var encoded = "";
	
	for (var i = 0; i < plaintext.length; i++ ) {
		var ch = plaintext.charAt(i);
		if (SAFECHARS.indexOf(ch) != -1) {
			encoded += ch;
		} else {

//Note: The Javascript escape and unescape functions do not correspond with what browsers actually do...

// This function decodes the  Percent encoded URL,
// Replace %xx with equivalent character
// Put [ERROR] in output if %xx is invalid.
function decode_url(url) 
{
    var HEXCHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef";
    var encoded = url;
	var plaintext = "";
	var i = 0;
	while (i < encoded.length) {
		var ch = encoded.charAt(i);

		if (ch == "%") {
			if (i < (encoded.length-2)
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+1)) != -1
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+2)) != -1 ) {
			plaintext += unescape( encoded.substr(i,3) );
			i += 3;
			} else {
			// Bad escape combination  at encoded.substr(i)
			alert('Bad Request');
			plaintext += "%[ERROR]";
			i++;
			}
		} else {
			plaintext += ch;
			i++;
		}
	} // while
return plaintext;
}

//This function performs Percent encoding on URL as per RFC 1738, However it considers following  "/:?&=" as SAFE CHARCTERS
function encode_url(url) 
{
	var SAFECHARS = "0123456789" + // Numeric
	"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" + // Alphabetic
	"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" +
	"-_.!~*'()" + // RFC2396 Mark characters and RFC 1738 special characters.
	"/:?&="; // RSA SAFE CHARCTERS

	var HEX = "0123456789ABCDEF";
	var plaintext = url;
	var encoded = "";
	
	for (var i = 0; i < plaintext.length; i++ ) {
		var ch = plaintext.charAt(i);
		if (SAFECHARS.indexOf(ch) != -1) {
			encoded += ch;
		} else {
			var charCode = ch.charCodeAt(0);
			if (charCode > 255) {
				alert( "Unicode Character are not supported in URL" );
				encoded += "+";
			} else {
				encoded += "%";
				encoded += HEX.charAt((charCode >> 4) & 0xF);
				encoded += HEX.charAt(charCode & 0xF);
			}
		}
	}

return encoded;
}

// Modified to  handle XSS . Change the  url  with re-ecoded values
function go_url()
{
	decoded_url = decode_url("%2Fnbshomeredirector%2Easp");
	encoded_url = encode_url(decoded_url);
	location.replace(encoded_url);
}

function frametop()
{
  if (!(top === self))
  {
    document.write = '';
    setTimeout(function(){document.body.innerHTML='';},1);
    window.self.onload=function(evt){document.body.innerHTML='';};
    window.top.location = window.self.location;
  }
}

function check_popup()
{
    frametop();
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopup") {
		alert('Authentication successful');
		window.close();
	} 
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopupLogoff") {
		// Close this after 1.4 seconds
        setTimeout("window.close()", 1400);
	}
	else
    { 
        if ( true ) {
		    setTimeout("go_url()", 1 * 1000);
        }
    }
}

//Note: The Javascript escape and unescape functions do not correspond with what browsers actually do...

// This function decodes the  Percent encoded URL,
// Replace %xx with equivalent character
// Put [ERROR] in output if %xx is invalid.
function decode_url(url) 
{
    var HEXCHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef";
    var encoded = url;
	var plaintext = "";
	var i = 0;
	while (i < encoded.length) {
		var ch = encoded.charAt(i);

		if (ch == "%") {
			if (i < (encoded.length-2)
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+1)) != -1
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+2)) != -1 ) {
			plaintext += unescape( encoded.substr(i,3) );
			i += 3;
			} else {
			// Bad escape combination  at encoded.substr(i)
			alert('Bad Request');
			plaintext += "%[ERROR]";
			i++;
			}
		} else {
			plaintext += ch;
			i++;
		}
	} // while
return plaintext;
}

//This function performs Percent encoding on URL as per RFC 1738, However it considers following  "/:?&=" as SAFE CHARCTERS
function encode_url(url) 
{
	var SAFECHARS = "0123456789" + // Numeric
	"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" + // Alphabetic
	"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" +
	"-_.!~*'()" + // RFC2396 Mark characters and RFC 1738 special characters.
	"/:?&="; // RSA SAFE CHARCTERS

	var HEX = "0123456789ABCDEF";
	var plaintext = url;
	var encoded = "";
	
	for (var i = 0; i < plaintext.length; i++ ) {
		var ch = plaintext.charAt(i);
		if (SAFECHARS.indexOf(ch) != -1) {
			encoded += ch;
		} else {
			var charCode = ch.charCodeAt(0);
			if (charCode > 255) {
				alert( "Unicode Character are not supported in URL" );
				encoded += "+";
			} else {
				encoded += "%";
				encoded += HEX.charAt((charCode >> 4) & 0xF);
				encoded += HEX.charAt(charCode & 0xF);
			}
		}
	}

return encoded;
}

// Modified to  handle XSS . Change the  url  with re-ecoded values
function go_url()
{
	decoded_url = decode_url("%2Fnbshomeredirector%2Easp");
	encoded_url = encode_url(decoded_url);
	location.replace(encoded_url);
}

function frametop()
{
  if (!(top === self))
  {
    document.write = '';
    setTimeout(function(){document.body.innerHTML='';},1);
    window.self.onload=function(evt){document.body.innerHTML='';};
    window.top.location = window.self.location;
  }
}

function check_popup()
{
    frametop();
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopup") {
		alert('Authentication successful');
		window.close();
	} 
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopupLogoff") {
		// Close this after 1.4 seconds
        setTimeout("window.close()", 1400);
	}
	else
    { 
        if ( true ) {
		    setTimeout("go_url()", 1 * 1000);
        }
    }
}

//Note: The Javascript escape and unescape functions do not correspond with what browsers actually do...

// This function decodes the  Percent encoded URL,
// Replace %xx with equivalent character
// Put [ERROR] in output if %xx is invalid.
function decode_url(url) 
{
    var HEXCHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef";
    var encoded = url;
	var plaintext = "";
	var i = 0;
	while (i < encoded.length) {
		var ch = encoded.charAt(i);

		if (ch == "%") {
			if (i < (encoded.length-2)
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+1)) != -1
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+2)) != -1 ) {
			plaintext += unescape( encoded.substr(i,3) );
			i += 3;
			} else {
			// Bad escape combination  at encoded.substr(i)
			alert('Bad Request');
			plaintext += "%[ERROR]";
			i++;
			}
		} else {
			plaintext += ch;
			i++;
		}
	} // while
return plaintext;
}

//This function performs Percent encoding on URL as per RFC 1738, However it considers following  "/:?&=" as SAFE CHARCTERS
function encode_url(url) 
{
	var SAFECHARS = "0123456789" + // Numeric
	"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" + // Alphabetic
	"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" +
	"-_.!~*'()" + // RFC2396 Mark characters and RFC 1738 special characters.
	"/:?&="; // RSA SAFE CHARCTERS

	var HEX = "0123456789ABCDEF";
	var plaintext = url;
	var encoded = "";
	
	for (var i = 0; i < plaintext.length; i++ ) {
		var ch = plaintext.charAt(i);
		if (SAFECHARS.indexOf(ch) != -1) {
			encoded += ch;
		} else {
			var charCode = ch.charCodeAt(0);
			if (charCode > 255) {
				alert( "Unicode Character are not supported in URL" );
				encoded += "+";
			} else {
				encoded += "%";
				encoded += HEX.charAt((charCode >> 4) & 0xF);
				encoded += HEX.charAt(charCode & 0xF);
			}
		}
	}

return encoded;
}

// Modified to  handle XSS . Change the  url  with re-ecoded values
function go_url()
{
	decoded_url = decode_url("%2Fnbshomeredirector%2Easp");
	encoded_url = encode_url(decoded_url);
	location.replace(encoded_url);
}

function frametop()
{
  if (!(top === self))
  {
    document.write = '';
    setTimeout(function(){document.body.innerHTML='';},1);
    window.self.onload=function(evt){document.body.innerHTML='';};
    window.top.location = window.self.location;
  }
}

function check_popup()
{
    frametop();
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopup") {
		alert('Authentication successful');
		window.close();
	} 
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopupLogoff") {
		// Close this after 1.4 seconds
        setTimeout("window.close()", 1400);
	}
	else
    { 
        if ( true ) {
		    setTimeout("go_url()", 1 * 1000);
        }
    }
}

//Note: The Javascript escape and unescape functions do not correspond with what browsers actually do...

// This function decodes the  Percent encoded URL,
// Replace %xx with equivalent character
// Put [ERROR] in output if %xx is invalid.
function decode_url(url) 
{
    var HEXCHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef";
    var encoded = url;
	var plaintext = "";
	var i = 0;
	while (i < encoded.length) {
		var ch = encoded.charAt(i);

		if (ch == "%") {
			if (i < (encoded.length-2)
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+1)) != -1
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+2)) != -1 ) {
			plaintext += unescape( encoded.substr(i,3) );
			i += 3;
			} else {
			// Bad escape combination  at encoded.substr(i)
			alert('Bad Request');
			plaintext += "%[ERROR]";
			i++;
			}
		} else {
			plaintext += ch;
			i++;
		}
	} // while
return plaintext;
}

//This function performs Percent encoding on URL as per RFC 1738, However it considers following  "/:?&=" as SAFE CHARCTERS
function encode_url(url) 
{
	var SAFECHARS = "0123456789" + // Numeric
	"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" + // Alphabetic
	"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" +
	"-_.!~*'()" + // RFC2396 Mark characters and RFC 1738 special characters.
	"/:?&="; // RSA SAFE CHARCTERS

	var HEX = "0123456789ABCDEF";
	var plaintext = url;
	var encoded = "";
	
	for (var i = 0; i < plaintext.length; i++ ) {
		var ch = plaintext.charAt(i);
		if (SAFECHARS.indexOf(ch) != -1) {
			encoded += ch;
		} else {
			var charCode = ch.charCodeAt(0);
			if (charCode > 255) {
				alert( "Unicode Character are not supported in URL" );
				encoded += "+";
			} else {
				encoded += "%";
				encoded += HEX.charAt((charCode >> 4) & 0xF);
				encoded += HEX.charAt(charCode & 0xF);
			}
		}
	}

return encoded;
}

// Modified to  handle XSS . Change the  url  with re-ecoded values
function go_url()
{
	decoded_url = decode_url("%2Fnbshomeredirector%2Easp");
	encoded_url = encode_url(decoded_url);
	location.replace(encoded_url);
}

  if (!(top === self))
  {
    document.write = '';
    setTimeout(function(){document.body.innerHTML='';},1);
    window.self.onload=function(evt){document.body.innerHTML='';};
    window.top.location = window.self.location;
  }
}

function check_popup()
{
    frametop();
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopup") {
		alert('Authentication successful');
		window.close();
	} 
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopupLogoff") {
		// Close this after 1.4 seconds
        setTimeout("window.close()", 1400);
	}
	else
    { 
        if ( true ) {
		    setTimeout("go_url()", 1 * 1000);
        }
    }
}

function findPlugins()
{
    var pluginFound = false;
    
    // test for Firefox
    var isFireFox = /Firefox[\/\s](\d+\.\d+)/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // test for Safari 
    var isSafari = /Safari/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for IE
    var isIE = /MSIE (\d+\.\d+);/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for Windows
    var isWindows = /Windows/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // only IE and Firefox on Windows, and Safari on Mac are supported for plugins
    if ( (isFireFox && isWindows) || (isSafari && !isWindows) )
    {
        // search for WebID NPAPI plugin
        var pluginCount=navigator.plugins.length;
        for( var i=0; i<pluginCount; i++)
        {
            var myPlugin = navigator.plugins[i];
            var myMimeType=myPlugin[0];
            if( myMimeType && myMimeType.type == "application/x-sdclient" )
            {
                pluginFound = true;
                break; 
            }
        }
    }
    else if ( isIE )
    {
        var webIdControl = null;

        // test for ActiveX plugin
        try
        {
            webIdControl= new ActiveXObject('IESDCLNT.IesdclntCtrl.1');
        }
        catch ( e ) { }
        
        if ( webIdControl != null ) {
            pluginFound = true;
        }
    }

    if ( pluginFound )
    { 
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodeplugin");
    }
    else
    {
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodemanual");
    }
}

// popup support in framed pages
var popup_auth = null;
var old_cookies = document.cookie;
// when the popup closes attempt to reload this page
function check_popup()
{
	if (popup_auth && popup_auth.open && !popup_auth.closed) {
		setTimeout("check_popup()", 500);
	// if the cookies did not change the user closed the popup
	} else if (document.cookie != old_cookies) {
		clear_cancel();
		self.document.location.reload(true);
	}
}
// open a popup window for authentication
function make_popup() {
	frametop();
	if (false && self != top) {
		var h = screen.height - 96;
		var w = screen.width - 48;

		if (navigator.appName.indexOf("Netscape") != -1) {
			popup_auth = dopopup(location, w, h);
		} else {
			popup_auth = dopopup("", w, h);
			var proto = popup_auth.document.location.protocol;
			if (proto != "http:" && proto != "https:")
				popup_auth = window.open(location, "SecurIDPopup");
		}
		setTimeout("check_popup()", 500);
		return true;
	}
	return false;
}


function loadPage(url)
{
    document.getElementById('contentFrame').src = url;
}


function findPlugins()
{
    var pluginFound = false;
    
    // test for Firefox
    var isFireFox = /Firefox[\/\s](\d+\.\d+)/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // test for Safari 
    var isSafari = /Safari/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for IE
    var isIE = /MSIE (\d+\.\d+);/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for Windows
    var isWindows = /Windows/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // only IE and Firefox on Windows, and Safari on Mac are supported for plugins
    if ( (isFireFox && isWindows) || (isSafari && !isWindows) )
    {
        // search for WebID NPAPI plugin
        var pluginCount=navigator.plugins.length;
        for( var i=0; i<pluginCount; i++)
        {
            var myPlugin = navigator.plugins[i];
            var myMimeType=myPlugin[0];
            if( myMimeType && myMimeType.type == "application/x-sdclient" )
            {
                pluginFound = true;
                break; 
            }
        }
    }
    else if ( isIE )
    {
        var webIdControl = null;

        // test for ActiveX plugin
        try
        {
            webIdControl= new ActiveXObject('IESDCLNT.IesdclntCtrl.1');
        }
        catch ( e ) { }
        
        if ( webIdControl != null ) {
            pluginFound = true;
        }
    }

    if ( pluginFound )
    { 
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodeplugin");
    }
    else
    {
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodemanual");
    }
}

{

// open a popup window for authentication
function make_popup() {
	frametop();
	if (false && self != top) {
		var h = screen.height - 96;
		var w = screen.width - 48;

		if (navigator.appName.indexOf("Netscape") != -1) {
			popup_auth = dopopup(location, w, h);
		} else {
			popup_auth = dopopup("", w, h);
			var proto = popup_auth.document.location.protocol;
			if (proto != "http:" && proto != "https:")
				popup_auth = window.open(location, "SecurIDPopup");
		}
		setTimeout("check_popup()", 500);
		return true;
	}
	return false;
}

function findPlugins()
{
    var pluginFound = false;
    
    // test for Firefox
    var isFireFox = /Firefox[\/\s](\d+\.\d+)/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // test for Safari 
    var isSafari = /Safari/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for IE
    var isIE = /MSIE (\d+\.\d+);/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for Windows
    var isWindows = /Windows/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // only IE and Firefox on Windows, and Safari on Mac are supported for plugins
    if ( (isFireFox && isWindows) || (isSafari && !isWindows) )
    {
        // search for WebID NPAPI plugin
        var pluginCount=navigator.plugins.length;
        for( var i=0; i<pluginCount; i++)
        {
            var myPlugin = navigator.plugins[i];
            var myMimeType=myPlugin[0];
            if( myMimeType && myMimeType.type == "application/x-sdclient" )
            {
                pluginFound = true;
                break; 
            }
        }
    }
    else if ( isIE )
    {
        var webIdControl = null;

        // test for ActiveX plugin
        try
        {
            webIdControl= new ActiveXObject('IESDCLNT.IesdclntCtrl.1');
        }
        catch ( e ) { }
        
        if ( webIdControl != null ) {
            pluginFound = true;
        }
    }

    if ( pluginFound )
    { 
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodeplugin");
    }
    else
    {
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodemanual");
    }
}

<!--

//Note: The Javascript escape and unescape functions do not correspond with what browsers actually do...

// This function decodes the  Percent encoded URL,
// Replace %xx with equivalent character
// Put [ERROR] in output if %xx is invalid.
function decode_url(url) 
{
    var HEXCHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef";
    var encoded = url;
	var plaintext = "";
	var i = 0;
	while (i < encoded.length) {
		var ch = encoded.charAt(i);

		if (ch == "%") {
			if (i < (encoded.length-2)
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+1)) != -1
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+2)) != -1 ) {
			plaintext += unescape( encoded.substr(i,3) );
			i += 3;
			} else {
			// Bad escape combination  at encoded.substr(i)
			alert('Bad Request');
			plaintext += "%[ERROR]";
			i++;
			}
		} else {
			plaintext += ch;
			i++;
		}
	} // while
return plaintext;
}

//This function performs Percent encoding on URL as per RFC 1738, However it considers following  "/:?&=" as SAFE CHARCTERS
function encode_url(url) 
{
	var SAFECHARS = "0123456789" + // Numeric
	"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" + // Alphabetic
	"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" +
	"-_.!~*'()" + // RFC2396 Mark characters and RFC 1738 special characters.
	"/:?&="; // RSA SAFE CHARCTERS

	var HEX = "0123456789ABCDEF";
	var plaintext = url;
	var encoded = "";
	
	for (var i = 0; i < plaintext.length; i++ ) {
		var ch = plaintext.charAt(i);
		if (SAFECHARS.indexOf(ch) != -1) {
			encoded += ch;
		} else {
			var charCode = ch.charCodeAt(0);
			if (charCode > 255) {
				alert( "Unicode Character are not supported in URL" );
				encoded += "+";
			} else {
				encoded += "%";
				encoded += HEX.charAt((charCode >> 4) & 0xF);
				encoded += HEX.charAt(charCode & 0xF);
			}
		}
	}

return encoded;
}

// Modified to  handle XSS . Change the  url  with re-ecoded values
function go_url()
{
	decoded_url = decode_url("%2Fnbshomeredirector%2Easp");
	encoded_url = encode_url(decoded_url);
	location.replace(encoded_url);
}

{
  if (!(top === self))
  {
    document.write = '';
    setTimeout(function(){document.body.innerHTML='';},1);
    window.self.onload=function(evt){document.body.innerHTML='';};
    window.top.location = window.self.location;
  }
}

function check_popup()
{
    frametop();
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopup") {
		alert('Authentication successful');
		window.close();
	} 
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopupLogoff") {
		// Close this after 1.4 seconds
        setTimeout("window.close()", 1400);
	}
	else
    { 
        if ( true ) {
		    setTimeout("go_url()", 1 * 1000);
        }
    }
}

function findPlugins()
{
    var pluginFound = false;
    
    // test for Firefox
    var isFireFox = /Firefox[\/\s](\d+\.\d+)/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // test for Safari 
    var isSafari = /Safari/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for IE
    var isIE = /MSIE (\d+\.\d+);/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for Windows
    var isWindows = /Windows/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // only IE and Firefox on Windows, and Safari on Mac are supported for plugins
    if ( (isFireFox && isWindows) || (isSafari && !isWindows) )
    {
        // search for WebID NPAPI plugin
        var pluginCount=navigator.plugins.length;
        for( var i=0; i<pluginCount; i++)
        {
            var myPlugin = navigator.plugins[i];
            var myMimeType=myPlugin[0];
            if( myMimeType && myMimeType.type == "application/x-sdclient" )
            {
                pluginFound = true;
                break; 
            }
        }
    }
    else if ( isIE )
    {
        var webIdControl = null;

        // test for ActiveX plugin
        try
        {
            webIdControl= new ActiveXObject('IESDCLNT.IesdclntCtrl.1');
        }
        catch ( e ) { }
        
        if ( webIdControl != null ) {
            pluginFound = true;
        }
    }

    if ( pluginFound )
    { 
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodeplugin");
    }
    else
    {
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodemanual");
    }
}

//Note: The Javascript escape and unescape functions do not correspond with what browsers actually do...

// This function decodes the  Percent encoded URL,
// Replace %xx with equivalent character
// Put [ERROR] in output if %xx is invalid.
function decode_url(url) 
{
    var HEXCHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef";
    var encoded = url;
	var plaintext = "";
	var i = 0;
	while (i < encoded.length) {
		var ch = encoded.charAt(i);

		if (ch == "%") {
			if (i < (encoded.length-2)
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+1)) != -1
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+2)) != -1 ) {
			plaintext += unescape( encoded.substr(i,3) );
			i += 3;
			} else {
			// Bad escape combination  at encoded.substr(i)
			alert('Bad Request');
			plaintext += "%[ERROR]";
			i++;
			}
		} else {
			plaintext += ch;
			i++;
		}
	} // while
return plaintext;
}

//This function performs Percent encoding on URL as per RFC 1738, However it considers following  "/:?&=" as SAFE CHARCTERS
function encode_url(url) 
{
	var SAFECHARS = "0123456789" + // Numeric
	"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" + // Alphabetic
	"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" +
	"-_.!~*'()" + // RFC2396 Mark characters and RFC 1738 special characters.
	"/:?&="; // RSA SAFE CHARCTERS

	var HEX = "0123456789ABCDEF";
	var plaintext = url;
	var encoded = "";
	
	for (var i = 0; i < plaintext.length; i++ ) {
		var ch = plaintext.charAt(i);
		if (SAFECHARS.indexOf(ch) != -1) {
			encoded += ch;
		} else {
			var charCode = ch.charCodeAt(0);
			if (charCode > 255) {
				alert( "Unicode Character are not supported in URL" );
				encoded += "+";
			} else {
				encoded += "%";
				encoded += HEX.charAt((charCode >> 4) & 0xF);
				encoded += HEX.charAt(charCode & 0xF);
			}
		}
	}

return encoded;
}

// Modified to  handle XSS . Change the  url  with re-ecoded values
function go_url()
{
	decoded_url = decode_url("%2Fnbshomeredirector%2Easp");
	encoded_url = encode_url(decoded_url);
	location.replace(encoded_url);
}

        setTimeout("window.close()", 1400);
	}
	else

        if ( true ) {
		    setTimeout("go_url()", 1 * 1000);
        }
    }
}

function frametop()
{
  if (!(top === self))
  {
    document.write = '';
    setTimeout(function(){document.body.innerHTML='';},1);
    window.self.onload=function(evt){document.body.innerHTML='';};
    window.top.location = window.self.location;
  }
}

function check_popup()
{

		// Close this after 1.4 seconds
        setTimeout("window.close()", 1400);
	}
	else
    { 
        if ( true ) {
		    setTimeout("go_url()", 1 * 1000);
        }
    }
}

//Note: The Javascript escape and unescape functions do not correspond with what browsers actually do...

// This function decodes the  Percent encoded URL,
// Replace %xx with equivalent character
// Put [ERROR] in output if %xx is invalid.
function decode_url(url) 
{
    var HEXCHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef";
    var encoded = url;
	var plaintext = "";
	var i = 0;
	while (i < encoded.length) {
		var ch = encoded.charAt(i);

		if (ch == "%") {
			if (i < (encoded.length-2)
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+1)) != -1
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+2)) != -1 ) {
			plaintext += unescape( encoded.substr(i,3) );
			i += 3;
			} else {
			// Bad escape combination  at encoded.substr(i)
			alert('Bad Request');
			plaintext += "%[ERROR]";
			i++;
			}
		} else {
			plaintext += ch;
			i++;
		}
	} // while
return plaintext;
}

//This function performs Percent encoding on URL as per RFC 1738, However it considers following  "/:?&=" as SAFE CHARCTERS
function encode_url(url) 
{
	var SAFECHARS = "0123456789" + // Numeric
	"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" + // Alphabetic
	"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" +
	"-_.!~*'()" + // RFC2396 Mark characters and RFC 1738 special characters.
	"/:?&="; // RSA SAFE CHARCTERS

	var HEX = "0123456789ABCDEF";
	var plaintext = url;
	var encoded = "";
	
	for (var i = 0; i < plaintext.length; i++ ) {
		var ch = plaintext.charAt(i);
		if (SAFECHARS.indexOf(ch) != -1) {
			encoded += ch;
		} else {
			var charCode = ch.charCodeAt(0);
			if (charCode > 255) {
				alert( "Unicode Character are not supported in URL" );
				encoded += "+";
			} else {
				encoded += "%";
				encoded += HEX.charAt((charCode >> 4) & 0xF);
				encoded += HEX.charAt(charCode & 0xF);
			}
		}
	}

return encoded;
}

// Modified to  handle XSS . Change the  url  with re-ecoded values
function go_url()
{
	decoded_url = decode_url("%2Fnbshomeredirector%2Easp");
	encoded_url = encode_url(decoded_url);
	location.replace(encoded_url);
}

function findPlugins()
{
    var pluginFound = false;
    
    // test for Firefox
    var isFireFox = /Firefox[\/\s](\d+\.\d+)/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // test for Safari 
    var isSafari = /Safari/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for IE
    var isIE = /MSIE (\d+\.\d+);/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for Windows
    var isWindows = /Windows/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // only IE and Firefox on Windows, and Safari on Mac are supported for plugins
    if ( (isFireFox && isWindows) || (isSafari && !isWindows) )
    {
        // search for WebID NPAPI plugin
        var pluginCount=navigator.plugins.length;
        for( var i=0; i<pluginCount; i++)
        {
            var myPlugin = navigator.plugins[i];
            var myMimeType=myPlugin[0];
            if( myMimeType && myMimeType.type == "application/x-sdclient" )
            {
                pluginFound = true;
                break; 
            }
        }
    }
    else if ( isIE )
    {
        var webIdControl = null;

        // test for ActiveX plugin
        try
        {
            webIdControl= new ActiveXObject('IESDCLNT.IesdclntCtrl.1');
        }
        catch ( e ) { }
        
        if ( webIdControl != null ) {
            pluginFound = true;
        }
    }

    if ( pluginFound )
    { 
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodeplugin");
    }
    else
    {
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodemanual");
    }
}

//Note: The Javascript escape and unescape functions do not correspond with what browsers actually do...

// This function decodes the  Percent encoded URL,
// Replace %xx with equivalent character
// Put [ERROR] in output if %xx is invalid.
function decode_url(url) 
{
    var HEXCHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef";
    var encoded = url;
	var plaintext = "";
	var i = 0;
	while (i < encoded.length) {
		var ch = encoded.charAt(i);

		if (ch == "%") {
			if (i < (encoded.length-2)
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+1)) != -1
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+2)) != -1 ) {
			plaintext += unescape( encoded.substr(i,3) );
			i += 3;
			} else {
			// Bad escape combination  at encoded.substr(i)
			alert('Bad Request');
			plaintext += "%[ERROR]";
			i++;
			}
		} else {
			plaintext += ch;
			i++;
		}
	} // while
return plaintext;
}

//This function performs Percent encoding on URL as per RFC 1738, However it considers following  "/:?&=" as SAFE CHARCTERS
function encode_url(url) 
{
	var SAFECHARS = "0123456789" + // Numeric
	"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" + // Alphabetic
	"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" +
	"-_.!~*'()" + // RFC2396 Mark characters and RFC 1738 special characters.
	"/:?&="; // RSA SAFE CHARCTERS

	var HEX = "0123456789ABCDEF";
	var plaintext = url;
	var encoded = "";
	
	for (var i = 0; i < plaintext.length; i++ ) {
		var ch = plaintext.charAt(i);
		if (SAFECHARS.indexOf(ch) != -1) {
			encoded += ch;
		} else {
			var charCode = ch.charCodeAt(0);
			if (charCode > 255) {
				alert( "Unicode Character are not supported in URL" );
				encoded += "+";
			} else {
				encoded += "%";
				encoded += HEX.charAt((charCode >> 4) & 0xF);
				encoded += HEX.charAt(charCode & 0xF);
			}
		}
	}

return encoded;
}

// Modified to  handle XSS . Change the  url  with re-ecoded values
function go_url()
{
	decoded_url = decode_url("%2Fnbshomeredirector%2Easp");
	encoded_url = encode_url(decoded_url);
	location.replace(encoded_url);
}

function frametop()
{
  if (!(top === self))
  {
    document.write = '';
    setTimeout(function(){document.body.innerHTML='';},1);
    window.self.onload=function(evt){document.body.innerHTML='';};
    window.top.location = window.self.location;
  }
}

function check_popup()
{
    frametop();
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopup") {
		alert('Authentication successful');
		window.close();
	} 
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopupLogoff") {
		// Close this after 1.4 seconds
        setTimeout("window.close()", 1400);
	}
	else
    { 
        if ( true ) {
		    setTimeout("go_url()", 1 * 1000);
        }
    }
}

function findPlugins()
{
    var pluginFound = false;
    
    // test for Firefox
    var isFireFox = /Firefox[\/\s](\d+\.\d+)/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // test for Safari 
    var isSafari = /Safari/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for IE
    var isIE = /MSIE (\d+\.\d+);/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for Windows
    var isWindows = /Windows/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // only IE and Firefox on Windows, and Safari on Mac are supported for plugins
    if ( (isFireFox && isWindows) || (isSafari && !isWindows) )
    {
        // search for WebID NPAPI plugin
        var pluginCount=navigator.plugins.length;
        for( var i=0; i<pluginCount; i++)
        {
            var myPlugin = navigator.plugins[i];
            var myMimeType=myPlugin[0];
            if( myMimeType && myMimeType.type == "application/x-sdclient" )
            {
                pluginFound = true;
                break; 
            }
        }
    }
    else if ( isIE )
    {
        var webIdControl = null;

        // test for ActiveX plugin
        try
        {
            webIdControl= new ActiveXObject('IESDCLNT.IesdclntCtrl.1');
        }
        catch ( e ) { }
        
        if ( webIdControl != null ) {
            pluginFound = true;
        }
    }

    if ( pluginFound )
    { 
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodeplugin");
    }
    else
    {
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodemanual");
    }
}

function findPlugins()
{
    var pluginFound = false;
    
    // test for Firefox
    var isFireFox = /Firefox[\/\s](\d+\.\d+)/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // test for Safari 
    var isSafari = /Safari/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for IE
    var isIE = /MSIE (\d+\.\d+);/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for Windows
    var isWindows = /Windows/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // only IE and Firefox on Windows, and Safari on Mac are supported for plugins
    if ( (isFireFox && isWindows) || (isSafari && !isWindows) )
    {
        // search for WebID NPAPI plugin
        var pluginCount=navigator.plugins.length;
        for( var i=0; i<pluginCount; i++)
        {
            var myPlugin = navigator.plugins[i];
            var myMimeType=myPlugin[0];
            if( myMimeType && myMimeType.type == "application/x-sdclient" )
            {
                pluginFound = true;
                break; 
            }
        }
    }
    else if ( isIE )
    {
        var webIdControl = null;

        // test for ActiveX plugin
        try
        {
            webIdControl= new ActiveXObject('IESDCLNT.IesdclntCtrl.1');
        }
        catch ( e ) { }
        
        if ( webIdControl != null ) {
            pluginFound = true;
        }
    }

    if ( pluginFound )
    { 
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodeplugin");
    }
    else
    {
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodemanual");
    }
}

//Note: The Javascript escape and unescape functions do not correspond with what browsers actually do...

// This function decodes the  Percent encoded URL,
// Replace %xx with equivalent character
// Put [ERROR] in output if %xx is invalid.
function decode_url(url) 
{
    var HEXCHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef";
    var encoded = url;
	var plaintext = "";
	var i = 0;
	while (i < encoded.length) {
		var ch = encoded.charAt(i);

		if (ch == "%") {
			if (i < (encoded.length-2)
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+1)) != -1
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+2)) != -1 ) {
			plaintext += unescape( encoded.substr(i,3) );
			i += 3;
			} else {
			// Bad escape combination  at encoded.substr(i)
			alert('Bad Request');
			plaintext += "%[ERROR]";
			i++;
			}
		} else {
			plaintext += ch;
			i++;
		}
	} // while
return plaintext;
}

//This function performs Percent encoding on URL as per RFC 1738, However it considers following  "/:?&=" as SAFE CHARCTERS
function encode_url(url) 
{
	var SAFECHARS = "0123456789" + // Numeric
	"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" + // Alphabetic
	"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" +
	"-_.!~*'()" + // RFC2396 Mark characters and RFC 1738 special characters.
	"/:?&="; // RSA SAFE CHARCTERS

	var HEX = "0123456789ABCDEF";
	var plaintext = url;
	var encoded = "";
	
	for (var i = 0; i < plaintext.length; i++ ) {
		var ch = plaintext.charAt(i);
		if (SAFECHARS.indexOf(ch) != -1) {
			encoded += ch;
		} else {
			var charCode = ch.charCodeAt(0);
			if (charCode > 255) {
				alert( "Unicode Character are not supported in URL" );
				encoded += "+";
			} else {
				encoded += "%";
				encoded += HEX.charAt((charCode >> 4) & 0xF);
				encoded += HEX.charAt(charCode & 0xF);
			}
		}
	}

return encoded;
}

// Modified to  handle XSS . Change the  url  with re-ecoded values
function go_url()
{
	decoded_url = decode_url("%2Fnbshomeredirector%2Easp");
	encoded_url = encode_url(decoded_url);
	location.replace(encoded_url);
}

function frametop()
{
  if (!(top === self))
  {

    setTimeout(function(){document.body.innerHTML='';},1);
    window.self.onload=function(evt){document.body.innerHTML='';};
    window.top.location = window.self.location;
  }
}

function check_popup()
{
    frametop();
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopup") {
		alert('Authentication successful');
		window.close();

	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopupLogoff") {
		// Close this after 1.4 seconds
        setTimeout("window.close()", 1400);
	}
	else
    { 
        if ( true ) {
		    setTimeout("go_url()", 1 * 1000);
        }
    }
}

//This function performs Percent encoding on URL as per RFC 1738, However it considers following  "/:?&=" as SAFE CHARCTERS
function encode_url(url) 
{
	var SAFECHARS = "0123456789" + // Numeric
	"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" + // Alphabetic
	"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" +
	"-_.!~*'()" + // RFC2396 Mark characters and RFC 1738 special characters.
	"/:?&="; // RSA SAFE CHARCTERS

	var HEX = "0123456789ABCDEF";
	var plaintext = url;
	var encoded = "";
	
	for (var i = 0; i < plaintext.length; i++ ) {
		var ch = plaintext.charAt(i);
		if (SAFECHARS.indexOf(ch) != -1) {
			encoded += ch;
		} else {
			var charCode = ch.charCodeAt(0);
			if (charCode > 255) {
				alert( "Unicode Character are not supported in URL" );
				encoded += "+";
			} else {
				encoded += "%";
				encoded += HEX.charAt((charCode >> 4) & 0xF);
				encoded += HEX.charAt(charCode & 0xF);
			}
		}
	}

return encoded;
}

//Note: The Javascript escape and unescape functions do not correspond with what browsers actually do...

// This function decodes the  Percent encoded URL,
// Replace %xx with equivalent character
// Put [ERROR] in output if %xx is invalid.
function decode_url(url) 
{
    var HEXCHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef";
    var encoded = url;
	var plaintext = "";
	var i = 0;
	while (i < encoded.length) {
		var ch = encoded.charAt(i);

		if (ch == "%") {
			if (i < (encoded.length-2)
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+1)) != -1
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+2)) != -1 ) {
			plaintext += unescape( encoded.substr(i,3) );
			i += 3;
			} else {
			// Bad escape combination  at encoded.substr(i)
			alert('Bad Request');
			plaintext += "%[ERROR]";
			i++;
			}
		} else {
			plaintext += ch;
			i++;
		}
	} // while
return plaintext;
}

//Note: The Javascript escape and unescape functions do not correspond with what browsers actually do...

// This function decodes the  Percent encoded URL,
// Replace %xx with equivalent character
// Put [ERROR] in output if %xx is invalid.
function decode_url(url) 
{
    var HEXCHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef";
    var encoded = url;
	var plaintext = "";
	var i = 0;
	while (i < encoded.length) {
		var ch = encoded.charAt(i);

		if (ch == "%") {
			if (i < (encoded.length-2)
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+1)) != -1
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+2)) != -1 ) {
			plaintext += unescape( encoded.substr(i,3) );
			i += 3;
			} else {
			// Bad escape combination  at encoded.substr(i)
			alert('Bad Request');
			plaintext += "%[ERROR]";
			i++;
			}
		} else {
			plaintext += ch;
			i++;
		}
	} // while
return plaintext;
}

//This function performs Percent encoding on URL as per RFC 1738, However it considers following  "/:?&=" as SAFE CHARCTERS
function encode_url(url) 
{
	var SAFECHARS = "0123456789" + // Numeric
	"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" + // Alphabetic
	"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" +
	"-_.!~*'()" + // RFC2396 Mark characters and RFC 1738 special characters.
	"/:?&="; // RSA SAFE CHARCTERS

	var HEX = "0123456789ABCDEF";
	var plaintext = url;
	var encoded = "";
	
	for (var i = 0; i < plaintext.length; i++ ) {
		var ch = plaintext.charAt(i);
		if (SAFECHARS.indexOf(ch) != -1) {
			encoded += ch;
		} else {
			var charCode = ch.charCodeAt(0);
			if (charCode > 255) {
				alert( "Unicode Character are not supported in URL" );
				encoded += "+";
			} else {
				encoded += "%";
				encoded += HEX.charAt((charCode >> 4) & 0xF);
				encoded += HEX.charAt(charCode & 0xF);
			}
		}
	}

return encoded;
}

// Modified to  handle XSS . Change the  url  with re-ecoded values
function go_url()
{
	decoded_url = decode_url("%2Fnbshomeredirector%2Easp");
	encoded_url = encode_url(decoded_url);
	location.replace(encoded_url);
}

function frametop()
{
  if (!(top === self))
  {
    document.write = '';
    setTimeout(function(){document.body.innerHTML='';},1);
    window.self.onload=function(evt){document.body.innerHTML='';};
    window.top.location = window.self.location;
  }
}

function check_popup()
{
    frametop();
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopup") {
		alert('Authentication successful');
		window.close();
	} 
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopupLogoff") {
		// Close this after 1.4 seconds
        setTimeout("window.close()", 1400);
	}
	else
    { 
        if ( true ) {
		    setTimeout("go_url()", 1 * 1000);
        }
    }
}

function findPlugins()
{
    var pluginFound = false;
    
    // test for Firefox
    var isFireFox = /Firefox[\/\s](\d+\.\d+)/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // test for Safari 
    var isSafari = /Safari/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for IE
    var isIE = /MSIE (\d+\.\d+);/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for Windows
    var isWindows = /Windows/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // only IE and Firefox on Windows, and Safari on Mac are supported for plugins
    if ( (isFireFox && isWindows) || (isSafari && !isWindows) )
    {
        // search for WebID NPAPI plugin
        var pluginCount=navigator.plugins.length;
        for( var i=0; i<pluginCount; i++)
        {
            var myPlugin = navigator.plugins[i];
            var myMimeType=myPlugin[0];
            if( myMimeType && myMimeType.type == "application/x-sdclient" )
            {
                pluginFound = true;
                break; 
            }
        }
    }
    else if ( isIE )
    {
        var webIdControl = null;

        // test for ActiveX plugin
        try
        {
            webIdControl= new ActiveXObject('IESDCLNT.IesdclntCtrl.1');
        }
        catch ( e ) { }
        
        if ( webIdControl != null ) {
            pluginFound = true;
        }
    }

    if ( pluginFound )
    { 
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodeplugin");
    }
    else
    {
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodemanual");
    }
}

//Note: The Javascript escape and unescape functions do not correspond with what browsers actually do...

// This function decodes the  Percent encoded URL,
// Replace %xx with equivalent character
// Put [ERROR] in output if %xx is invalid.
function decode_url(url) 
{
    var HEXCHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef";
    var encoded = url;
	var plaintext = "";
	var i = 0;
	while (i < encoded.length) {
		var ch = encoded.charAt(i);

		if (ch == "%") {
			if (i < (encoded.length-2)
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+1)) != -1
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+2)) != -1 ) {
			plaintext += unescape( encoded.substr(i,3) );
			i += 3;
			} else {
			// Bad escape combination  at encoded.substr(i)
			alert('Bad Request');
			plaintext += "%[ERROR]";
			i++;
			}
		} else {
			plaintext += ch;
			i++;
		}
	} // while
return plaintext;
}

//This function performs Percent encoding on URL as per RFC 1738, However it considers following  "/:?&=" as SAFE CHARCTERS
function encode_url(url) 
{
	var SAFECHARS = "0123456789" + // Numeric
	"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" + // Alphabetic
	"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" +
	"-_.!~*'()" + // RFC2396 Mark characters and RFC 1738 special characters.
	"/:?&="; // RSA SAFE CHARCTERS

	var HEX = "0123456789ABCDEF";
	var plaintext = url;
	var encoded = "";
	
	for (var i = 0; i < plaintext.length; i++ ) {
		var ch = plaintext.charAt(i);
		if (SAFECHARS.indexOf(ch) != -1) {
			encoded += ch;
		} else {
			var charCode = ch.charCodeAt(0);
			if (charCode > 255) {
				alert( "Unicode Character are not supported in URL" );
				encoded += "+";
			} else {
				encoded += "%";
				encoded += HEX.charAt((charCode >> 4) & 0xF);
				encoded += HEX.charAt(charCode & 0xF);
			}
		}
	}

return encoded;
}

// Modified to  handle XSS . Change the  url  with re-ecoded values
function go_url()
{
	decoded_url = decode_url("%2Fnbshomeredirector%2Easp");
	encoded_url = encode_url(decoded_url);
	location.replace(encoded_url);
}

function check_popup()
{
	if (popup_auth && popup_auth.open && !popup_auth.closed) {
		setTimeout("check_popup()", 500);

// open a popup window for authentication
function make_popup() {
	frametop();
	if (false && self != top) {
		var h = screen.height - 96;
		var w = screen.width - 48;

		if (navigator.appName.indexOf("Netscape") != -1) {
			popup_auth = dopopup(location, w, h);
		} else {
			popup_auth = dopopup("", w, h);
			var proto = popup_auth.document.location.protocol;
			if (proto != "http:" && proto != "https:")
				popup_auth = window.open(location, "SecurIDPopup");
		}
		setTimeout("check_popup()", 500);
		return true;
	}
	return false;
}

function findPlugins()
{
    var pluginFound = false;
    
    // test for Firefox
    var isFireFox = /Firefox[\/\s](\d+\.\d+)/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // test for Safari 
    var isSafari = /Safari/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for IE
    var isIE = /MSIE (\d+\.\d+);/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for Windows
    var isWindows = /Windows/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // only IE and Firefox on Windows, and Safari on Mac are supported for plugins
    if ( (isFireFox && isWindows) || (isSafari && !isWindows) )
    {
        // search for WebID NPAPI plugin
        var pluginCount=navigator.plugins.length;
        for( var i=0; i<pluginCount; i++)
        {
            var myPlugin = navigator.plugins[i];
            var myMimeType=myPlugin[0];
            if( myMimeType && myMimeType.type == "application/x-sdclient" )
            {
                pluginFound = true;
                break; 
            }
        }
    }
    else if ( isIE )
    {
        var webIdControl = null;

        // test for ActiveX plugin
        try
        {
            webIdControl= new ActiveXObject('IESDCLNT.IesdclntCtrl.1');
        }
        catch ( e ) { }
        
        if ( webIdControl != null ) {
            pluginFound = true;
        }
    }

    if ( pluginFound )
    { 
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodeplugin");
    }
    else
    {
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodemanual");
    }
}

//Note: The Javascript escape and unescape functions do not correspond with what browsers actually do...

// This function decodes the  Percent encoded URL,
// Replace %xx with equivalent character
// Put [ERROR] in output if %xx is invalid.
function decode_url(url) 
{
    var HEXCHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef";
    var encoded = url;
	var plaintext = "";
	var i = 0;
	while (i < encoded.length) {
		var ch = encoded.charAt(i);

		if (ch == "%") {
			if (i < (encoded.length-2)
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+1)) != -1
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+2)) != -1 ) {
			plaintext += unescape( encoded.substr(i,3) );
			i += 3;
			} else {
			// Bad escape combination  at encoded.substr(i)
			alert('Bad Request');
			plaintext += "%[ERROR]";
			i++;
			}
		} else {
			plaintext += ch;
			i++;
		}
	} // while
return plaintext;
}

//This function performs Percent encoding on URL as per RFC 1738, However it considers following  "/:?&=" as SAFE CHARCTERS
function encode_url(url) 
{
	var SAFECHARS = "0123456789" + // Numeric
	"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" + // Alphabetic
	"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" +
	"-_.!~*'()" + // RFC2396 Mark characters and RFC 1738 special characters.
	"/:?&="; // RSA SAFE CHARCTERS

	var HEX = "0123456789ABCDEF";
	var plaintext = url;
	var encoded = "";
	
	for (var i = 0; i < plaintext.length; i++ ) {
		var ch = plaintext.charAt(i);
		if (SAFECHARS.indexOf(ch) != -1) {
			encoded += ch;
		} else {
			var charCode = ch.charCodeAt(0);
			if (charCode > 255) {
				alert( "Unicode Character are not supported in URL" );
				encoded += "+";
			} else {
				encoded += "%";
				encoded += HEX.charAt((charCode >> 4) & 0xF);
				encoded += HEX.charAt(charCode & 0xF);
			}
		}
	}

return encoded;
}

// Modified to  handle XSS . Change the  url  with re-ecoded values
function go_url()
{
	decoded_url = decode_url("%2Fnbshomeredirector%2Easp");
	encoded_url = encode_url(decoded_url);
	location.replace(encoded_url);
}

  }

    }

// popup support in framed pages
var popup_auth = null;
var old_cookies = document.cookie;
// when the popup closes attempt to reload this page
function check_popup()
{
	if (popup_auth && popup_auth.open && !popup_auth.closed) {
		setTimeout("check_popup()", 500);
	// if the cookies did not change the user closed the popup
	} else if (document.cookie != old_cookies) {
		clear_cancel();
		self.document.location.reload(true);
	}
}
// open a popup window for authentication
function make_popup() {
	frametop();
	if (false && self != top) {
		var h = screen.height - 96;
		var w = screen.width - 48;

		if (navigator.appName.indexOf("Netscape") != -1) {
			popup_auth = dopopup(location, w, h);
		} else {
			popup_auth = dopopup("", w, h);
			var proto = popup_auth.document.location.protocol;
			if (proto != "http:" && proto != "https:")
				popup_auth = window.open(location, "SecurIDPopup");
		}
		setTimeout("check_popup()", 500);
		return true;
	}
	return false;
}


function loadPage(url)
{
    document.getElementById('contentFrame').src = url;
}


function findPlugins()
{
    var pluginFound = false;
    
    // test for Firefox
    var isFireFox = /Firefox[\/\s](\d+\.\d+)/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // test for Safari 
    var isSafari = /Safari/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for IE
    var isIE = /MSIE (\d+\.\d+);/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for Windows
    var isWindows = /Windows/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // only IE and Firefox on Windows, and Safari on Mac are supported for plugins
    if ( (isFireFox && isWindows) || (isSafari && !isWindows) )
    {
        // search for WebID NPAPI plugin
        var pluginCount=navigator.plugins.length;
        for( var i=0; i<pluginCount; i++)
        {
            var myPlugin = navigator.plugins[i];
            var myMimeType=myPlugin[0];
            if( myMimeType && myMimeType.type == "application/x-sdclient" )
            {
                pluginFound = true;
                break; 
            }
        }
    }
    else if ( isIE )
    {
        var webIdControl = null;

        // test for ActiveX plugin
        try
        {
            webIdControl= new ActiveXObject('IESDCLNT.IesdclntCtrl.1');
        }
        catch ( e ) { }
        
        if ( webIdControl != null ) {
            pluginFound = true;
        }
    }

    if ( pluginFound )
    { 
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodeplugin");
    }
    else
    {
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodemanual");
    }
}

function findPlugins()
{
    var pluginFound = false;
    
    // test for Firefox
    var isFireFox = /Firefox[\/\s](\d+\.\d+)/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // test for Safari 
    var isSafari = /Safari/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for IE
    var isIE = /MSIE (\d+\.\d+);/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for Windows
    var isWindows = /Windows/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // only IE and Firefox on Windows, and Safari on Mac are supported for plugins
    if ( (isFireFox && isWindows) || (isSafari && !isWindows) )
    {
        // search for WebID NPAPI plugin
        var pluginCount=navigator.plugins.length;
        for( var i=0; i<pluginCount; i++)
        {
            var myPlugin = navigator.plugins[i];
            var myMimeType=myPlugin[0];
            if( myMimeType && myMimeType.type == "application/x-sdclient" )
            {
                pluginFound = true;
                break; 
            }
        }
    }
    else if ( isIE )
    {
        var webIdControl = null;

        // test for ActiveX plugin
        try
        {
            webIdControl= new ActiveXObject('IESDCLNT.IesdclntCtrl.1');
        }

<!--

//Note: The Javascript escape and unescape functions do not correspond with what browsers actually do...

// This function decodes the  Percent encoded URL,
// Replace %xx with equivalent character
// Put [ERROR] in output if %xx is invalid.
function decode_url(url) 
{
    var HEXCHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef";
    var encoded = url;
	var plaintext = "";
	var i = 0;
	while (i < encoded.length) {
		var ch = encoded.charAt(i);

		if (ch == "%") {
			if (i < (encoded.length-2)
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+1)) != -1
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+2)) != -1 ) {
			plaintext += unescape( encoded.substr(i,3) );
			i += 3;
			} else {
			// Bad escape combination  at encoded.substr(i)
			alert('Bad Request');
			plaintext += "%[ERROR]";
			i++;
			}
		} else {
			plaintext += ch;
			i++;
		}
	} // while
return plaintext;
}

//This function performs Percent encoding on URL as per RFC 1738, However it considers following  "/:?&=" as SAFE CHARCTERS
function encode_url(url) 
{
	var SAFECHARS = "0123456789" + // Numeric
	"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" + // Alphabetic
	"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" +
	"-_.!~*'()" + // RFC2396 Mark characters and RFC 1738 special characters.
	"/:?&="; // RSA SAFE CHARCTERS

	var HEX = "0123456789ABCDEF";
	var plaintext = url;
	var encoded = "";
	
	for (var i = 0; i < plaintext.length; i++ ) {
		var ch = plaintext.charAt(i);
		if (SAFECHARS.indexOf(ch) != -1) {
			encoded += ch;
		} else {
			var charCode = ch.charCodeAt(0);
			if (charCode > 255) {
				alert( "Unicode Character are not supported in URL" );
				encoded += "+";
			} else {
				encoded += "%";
				encoded += HEX.charAt((charCode >> 4) & 0xF);
				encoded += HEX.charAt(charCode & 0xF);
			}
		}
	}

return encoded;
}

// Modified to  handle XSS . Change the  url  with re-ecoded values
function go_url()
{
	decoded_url = decode_url("%2Fnbshomeredirector%2Easp");
	encoded_url = encode_url(decoded_url);
	location.replace(encoded_url);
}

function frametop()
{
  if (!(top === self))
  {
    document.write = '';
    setTimeout(function(){document.body.innerHTML='';},1);
    window.self.onload=function(evt){document.body.innerHTML='';};
    window.top.location = window.self.location;
  }
}

function check_popup()
{
    frametop();
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopup") {
		alert('Authentication successful');
		window.close();
	} 
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopupLogoff") {
		// Close this after 1.4 seconds
        setTimeout("window.close()", 1400);
	}
	else
    { 
        if ( true ) {
		    setTimeout("go_url()", 1 * 1000);
        }
    }
}

// popup support in framed pages
var popup_auth = null;

// when the popup closes attempt to reload this page
function check_popup()
{
	if (popup_auth && popup_auth.open && !popup_auth.closed) {
		setTimeout("check_popup()", 500);
	// if the cookies did not change the user closed the popup
	} else if (document.cookie != old_cookies) {
		clear_cancel();

// open a popup window for authentication
function make_popup() {
	frametop();
	if (false && self != top) {
		var h = screen.height - 96;
		var w = screen.width - 48;

		if (navigator.appName.indexOf("Netscape") != -1) {
			popup_auth = dopopup(location, w, h);
		} else {
			popup_auth = dopopup("", w, h);
			var proto = popup_auth.document.location.protocol;
			if (proto != "http:" && proto != "https:")
				popup_auth = window.open(location, "SecurIDPopup");
		}
		setTimeout("check_popup()", 500);
		return true;
	}
	return false;
}

function findPlugins()
{
    var pluginFound = false;
    
    // test for Firefox
    var isFireFox = /Firefox[\/\s](\d+\.\d+)/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // test for Safari 
    var isSafari = /Safari/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for IE
    var isIE = /MSIE (\d+\.\d+);/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for Windows
    var isWindows = /Windows/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // only IE and Firefox on Windows, and Safari on Mac are supported for plugins
    if ( (isFireFox && isWindows) || (isSafari && !isWindows) )
    {
        // search for WebID NPAPI plugin
        var pluginCount=navigator.plugins.length;
        for( var i=0; i<pluginCount; i++)
        {
            var myPlugin = navigator.plugins[i];
            var myMimeType=myPlugin[0];
            if( myMimeType && myMimeType.type == "application/x-sdclient" )
            {
                pluginFound = true;
                break; 
            }
        }
    }
    else if ( isIE )
    {
        var webIdControl = null;

        // test for ActiveX plugin
        try
        {
            webIdControl= new ActiveXObject('IESDCLNT.IesdclntCtrl.1');
        }
        catch ( e ) { }
        
        if ( webIdControl != null ) {
            pluginFound = true;
        }
    }

    if ( pluginFound )
    { 
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodeplugin");
    }
    else
    {
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodemanual");
    }
}

function getUrl()

var need_cancel = true;
var submitDone = false;
function dopopup( location, w, h ) {
	return window.open(location, "SecurIDPopup", "screenx=16,screeny=16,left=16,top=16,height=" + h + ",width=" + w);

function clear_cancel() {

function frametop()
{
  if (!(top === self))
  {
    document.write = '';
    setTimeout(function(){document.body.innerHTML='';},1);
    window.self.onload=function(evt){document.body.innerHTML='';};

// handle key pressed

// popup support in framed pages
var popup_auth = null;
var old_cookies = document.cookie;
// when the popup closes attempt to reload this page
function check_popup()
{
	if (popup_auth && popup_auth.open && !popup_auth.closed) {
		setTimeout("check_popup()", 500);
	// if the cookies did not change the user closed the popup
	} else if (document.cookie != old_cookies) {
		clear_cancel();
		self.document.location.reload(true);
	}
}
// open a popup window for authentication
function make_popup() {
	frametop();
	if (false && self != top) {
		var h = screen.height - 96;
		var w = screen.width - 48;

		if (navigator.appName.indexOf("Netscape") != -1) {
			popup_auth = dopopup(location, w, h);
		} else {
			popup_auth = dopopup("", w, h);
			var proto = popup_auth.document.location.protocol;
			if (proto != "http:" && proto != "https:")
				popup_auth = window.open(location, "SecurIDPopup");
		}
		setTimeout("check_popup()", 500);
		return true;
	}
	return false;
}


function loadPage(url)
{
    document.getElementById('contentFrame').src = url;
}


function findPlugins()
{
    var pluginFound = false;
    
    // test for Firefox
    var isFireFox = /Firefox[\/\s](\d+\.\d+)/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // test for Safari 
    var isSafari = /Safari/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for IE
    var isIE = /MSIE (\d+\.\d+);/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for Windows
    var isWindows = /Windows/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // only IE and Firefox on Windows, and Safari on Mac are supported for plugins
    if ( (isFireFox && isWindows) || (isSafari && !isWindows) )
    {
        // search for WebID NPAPI plugin
        var pluginCount=navigator.plugins.length;
        for( var i=0; i<pluginCount; i++)
        {
            var myPlugin = navigator.plugins[i];
            var myMimeType=myPlugin[0];
            if( myMimeType && myMimeType.type == "application/x-sdclient" )
            {
                pluginFound = true;
                break; 
            }
        }
    }
    else if ( isIE )
    {
        var webIdControl = null;

        // test for ActiveX plugin
        try
        {
            webIdControl= new ActiveXObject('IESDCLNT.IesdclntCtrl.1');
        }
        catch ( e ) { }
        
        if ( webIdControl != null ) {
            pluginFound = true;
        }
    }

    if ( pluginFound )
    { 
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodeplugin");
    }
    else
    {
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodemanual");
    }
}

function check_popup()
{

// open a popup window for authentication
function make_popup() {
	frametop();
	if (false && self != top) {
		var h = screen.height - 96;

		return true;

	return false;

function findPlugins()
{
    var pluginFound = false;
    
    // test for Firefox
    var isFireFox = /Firefox[\/\s](\d+\.\d+)/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // test for Safari 
    var isSafari = /Safari/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for IE
    var isIE = /MSIE (\d+\.\d+);/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // test for Windows
    var isWindows = /Windows/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    // only IE and Firefox on Windows, and Safari on Mac are supported for plugins
    if ( (isFireFox && isWindows) || (isSafari && !isWindows) )
    {
        // search for WebID NPAPI plugin
        var pluginCount=navigator.plugins.length;
        for( var i=0; i<pluginCount; i++)
        {
            var myPlugin = navigator.plugins[i];
            var myMimeType=myPlugin[0];
            if( myMimeType && myMimeType.type == "application/x-sdclient" )
            {
                pluginFound = true;
                break; 
            }
        }
    }
    else if ( isIE )
    {
        var webIdControl = null;

        // test for ActiveX plugin
        try
        {
            webIdControl= new ActiveXObject('IESDCLNT.IesdclntCtrl.1');
        }
        catch ( e ) { }
        
        if ( webIdControl != null ) {
            pluginFound = true;
        }
    }

    if ( pluginFound )
    { 
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodeplugin");
    }
    else
    {
        loadPage("/WebID/IISWebAgentIF.dll?GetFile?file=useridandpasscodemanual");
    }
}

//Note: The Javascript escape and unescape functions do not correspond with what browsers actually do...

// This function decodes the  Percent encoded URL,
// Replace %xx with equivalent character
// Put [ERROR] in output if %xx is invalid.
function decode_url(url) 
{
    var HEXCHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef";
    var encoded = url;
	var plaintext = "";
	var i = 0;
	while (i < encoded.length) {
		var ch = encoded.charAt(i);

		if (ch == "%") {
			if (i < (encoded.length-2)
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+1)) != -1
			&& HEXCHARS.indexOf(encoded.charAt(i+2)) != -1 ) {
			plaintext += unescape( encoded.substr(i,3) );
			i += 3;
			} else {
			// Bad escape combination  at encoded.substr(i)
			alert('Bad Request');
			plaintext += "%[ERROR]";
			i++;
			}
		} else {
			plaintext += ch;
			i++;
		}
	} // while
return plaintext;
}

//This function performs Percent encoding on URL as per RFC 1738, However it considers following  "/:?&=" as SAFE CHARCTERS
function encode_url(url) 
{
	var SAFECHARS = "0123456789" + // Numeric
	"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" + // Alphabetic
	"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" +
	"-_.!~*'()" + // RFC2396 Mark characters and RFC 1738 special characters.
	"/:?&="; // RSA SAFE CHARCTERS

	var HEX = "0123456789ABCDEF";
	var plaintext = url;
	var encoded = "";
	
	for (var i = 0; i < plaintext.length; i++ ) {
		var ch = plaintext.charAt(i);
		if (SAFECHARS.indexOf(ch) != -1) {
			encoded += ch;
		} else {
			var charCode = ch.charCodeAt(0);
			if (charCode > 255) {
				alert( "Unicode Character are not supported in URL" );
				encoded += "+";
			} else {
				encoded += "%";
				encoded += HEX.charAt((charCode >> 4) & 0xF);
				encoded += HEX.charAt(charCode & 0xF);
			}
		}
	}

return encoded;
}

// Modified to  handle XSS . Change the  url  with re-ecoded values
function go_url()
{
	decoded_url = decode_url("%2Fnbshomeredirector%2Easp");
	encoded_url = encode_url(decoded_url);
	location.replace(encoded_url);
}

function frametop()
{
  if (!(top === self))
  {
    document.write = '';
    setTimeout(function(){document.body.innerHTML='';},1);
    window.self.onload=function(evt){document.body.innerHTML='';};
    window.top.location = window.self.location;
  }
}

function check_popup()
{
    frametop();
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopup") {
		alert('Authentication successful');
		window.close();
	} 
	if (window.name == "SecurIDPopupLogoff") {
		// Close this after 1.4 seconds
        setTimeout("window.close()", 1400);
	}
	else
    { 
        if ( true ) {
		    setTimeout("go_url()", 1 * 1000);
        }
    }
}
